MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Control of Radio Communications.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1744, dated 14 July 1947, subject as above.
2. Inclosures 1 and 2 of this memorandum are the bimonthly lists of amendments, including all additions, deletions and changes to inclosures 1 and 2 of SCAPIN 1744/14 prepared and submitted in accordance with paragraphs 12 and 13 of reference 1.
3. This memorandum reaffirms the authorization of all amendments authorized by direct communications between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Communications during March and April 1949.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
